mapper.select: select u.id, u.tenant_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.mobile, u.email, u.password_hash, u.account_type, u.status, u.last_login_at from auth_user u inner join auth_user_identity i on u.id = i.user_id and u.tenant_id = i.tenant_id where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.provider_code = #{providerCode} and i.external_user_id = #{externalUserId} and i.enabled = 1 and u.deleted = 0
